messages:
Priya Nair: FYI we just got a vendor update — Zenith proposes a partial-return + refurb option instead of straight replacements for 10 affected H100s from PO Z-1902. They claim refurb will clear customs faster but only covers 70% of RMA credit (remainder is spare-pool credit). Thoughts?
George Li: what's turnaround on refurb vs new replacements? If refurb is same-day depot-ready and avoids long air freight, that's compelling. But 70% credit is not great. Need the depot QA criteria.
Marcus Green: need to know cost delta. Air replacement = $900/unit + $800 consolidation; refurb local depot swap = $350/unit handling + refurbishment fee $200. Total refurb per unit cheaper and faster. But refurb may carry higher failure risk — need burn-in plan.
zenith-ops: refurb ETA after depot acceptance: 5-7 business days to stage and test. Refurbished units come with 90-day swap warranty; we provide serial traceability. We can offer 85% credit if Redwood signs holdback agreement for spare pool retention.
Priya Nair: we can't accept refurbished units into production without 24h burn-in and thermal test. If vendor gives 85% credit, ok to accept 6 refurbished units to staging and 4 air-new for critical nodes.
George Li: confirm which nodes are critical — prod-cluster-west-2a has 3 flagged, prod-cluster-east-1 has 1. Rest to staging.
Marcus Green: I'll run a quick risk model: probability-of-failure on refurb assumed 3% during 90-day window; cost of replacement in that window if fails = air expedite $900+ops. Expected additional expected cost small but ops burden exists.
zenith-ops: we can commit to depot-level stress logs and test artifacts for each refurb unit to support acceptance. Also offering to include serial-level QA reports in the RMA package.
ops-bot: RMA updated: ZEN-RMA-2026-402 status changed to "depot-approved-for-refurb". Link: https://zenith.example.com/rma/ZEN-RMA-2026-402
Priya Nair: decision: accept hybrid plan — 4 air-new to production (critical), 6 refurb to FRA-staging with burn-in and test. Vendor to provide 85% credit for DOAs, applied to next invoice. Vendor to supply QA logs for each refurb. Finance to hold 85% as provisional credit until RMA disposition confirmed.
George Li: note: tag this plan in the incident ticket and update capacity forecast. We'll reserve spare slot in cluster for quick swap.
Marcus Green: prepping burn-in checklist and test harness. Will post checklist in 2h.
zenith-ops: arranging pickup and refurb processing. We'll post AWB and tracking once scheduled.
Priya Nair: thanks. Keep channel posted.
George Li: cc finance and legal if we need contract holdback language.
ops-bot: pickup scheduled ETA 2026-04-02 06:00 UTC.
